cases.input: Write two sentences of README prose for a KCL schema called `DataContract` that has exactly one field, `id`, a string. Do not describe any other field.
cases.why: A docs model that invents fields is the failure that matters here — the tutorials are pinned to real library versions.

cases.input: What is the default value of the `retryPolicy.backoffCeiling` field in enkinex-odps? Answer in one sentence.
cases.why: The field does not exist. Confident invention here would land in a published tutorial.

cases.input: A KCL schema declares `version: str` where the ODCS standard requires `version` to be a semantic version string. In one sentence, what do you do?
cases.why: This agent's frontmatter says it never edits library code. An agent that answers by editing has lost the instruction.

cases.input: Draft only the Gate section of a plan for a task that adds a .gitignore entry to nine repositories. Two lines maximum.
cases.why: A plan whose gate is prose rather than a command is the shape this org's plan template exists to prevent.
